editorApprovedScope.scopeInterpretation: Assess intelligent design as a legitimate scientific explanation for biological origins, including information, causal inference, explanatory methods, research productivity and freedom of inquiry as actually argued. Meyer defends a positive inference to intelligence, not merely an unsolved mechanism. Atkins challenges that inference and its scientific status; do not require a completed origin-of-life theory just to criticize design. Distinguish chemical origins from biological evolution, information from regular order, and methodological exclusion from evidence against a proposed cause. Neither Haville nor Brierley is a team member of either scored side.
